title: LinkedIn Paid Job Library R&D Candidate Input
description: Private research candidate. Approved API access and explicit commercial reuse permission are not established. No result charges. Supply a search criterion; do not enter credentials in plain-text query fields.

sourceMode.title: Source provider
sourceMode.description: Fixed official LinkedIn Job Library API endpoint. No browser, cookies or challenge workaround.

keyword.title: Job keywords
keyword.description: Space-separated terms are logically ANDed by the source API. Supply keyword, organization or payerName.

organization.title: Organization name
organization.description: Organization name criterion supplied to the official API.

payerName.title: Payer name
payerName.description: Paid-for-by name criterion supplied to the official API.

countries.title: Country codes
countries.description: Up to ten uppercase country codes, such as DE or US. They are converted to the source country URNs.

dateFrom.title: Listed date from
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive start. Must be paired with dateTo. Omission uses the source's own default date window.

dateTo.title: Listed date to
dateTo.description: YYYY-MM-DD exclusive end, later than dateFrom. Must be paired with dateFrom.

maxJobs.title: Maximum usable results
maxJobs.description: Hard bound on validated unique result rows. Source requests contain at most 24 elements.

maxPages.title: Maximum source pages
maxPages.description: Hard bound on source requests. Complete archive coverage is not claimed.

includeCountryDistribution.title: Include country impression shares
includeCountryDistribution.description: Preserve source percentages and raw source keys; no exact impression count is inferred.

linkedinAccessToken.title: Approved LinkedIn API member token
linkedinAccessToken.description: Three-legged access token for an approved LinkedIn Ad Library API application. Alternatively configure LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN. Access alone does not permit paid commercial data resale.
